title: Solstone transfer archive manifest v1
description: On-disk manifest.json as accepted by parse_manifest. created_at is Unix epoch milliseconds. This file is crate-local and not bundle-discovered.

created_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds (export.rs as_millis() as i64). No bounds.

x-journal-contract.write_discipline: First member of the transfer tar+gzip archive (manifest.json); written whole by export; never mutated in place

x-known-asymmetries: Observed, not decided: after parse_manifest succeeds, expected_members additionally requires each segment-key's time half to be exactly 6 ASCII digits, the duration half to be nonempty ASCII digits, and duration.parse::<u64>() to succeed and be greater than 0. There is no HHMMSS_LEN constant; the length check is the literal 6 in validate_segment_key.

Observed, not decided: expected_members also runs contained_path on the stream/key route under the day directory and on each file.name under the segment directory, rejecting path escape before any extraction.

Observed, not decided: buffer_members additionally requires each archive member's sha256 and size to match the manifest entry, and every expected member to be present in the archive; those checks are not part of parse_manifest.
